cv_pipeline_uav1.png.caption: Computer-vision stage on UAV 1's real 320x240 thermal frame: raw heat (ironbow and grey), histogram with the Otsu threshold, threshold mask, despeckle, connected components, centroid / box / principal axes, and the same frame seen from outside.
cv_pipeline_uav1.png.how: Rendered by the program (--capture --only lab_cv): raw heat from Renderer::captureUavCamera (view HeatRaw), stages from cv::detectTargetsDebug (the same functions as detectTargets), overlays with the Hud API. Moment chosen automatically: first frame with both UAVs holding a confirmed track.

cv_pipeline_uav2.png.caption: The same pipeline on UAV 2's frame at the same instant.

cv_u1_a_raw_ironbow.png.caption: (a) Raw heat image of UAV 1, 320x240 scaled x3 (nearest), ironbow palette.
cv_u1_a_raw_ironbow.png.how: Hud::heatImage of the R8 heat texture, nearest filter.

cv_u1_a_raw_grey.png.caption: (a) Raw heat image of UAV 1 in grey (white-hot palette).

cv_u1_b0_histogram.png.caption: Histogram (log counts) of the heat image with the fixed floor 204, the Otsu level and the threshold actually used.

cv_u1_b_mask.png.caption: (b) Threshold mask; the printed value is t = max(floor 204, Otsu + 1).

cv_u1_c_despeckle.png.caption: (c) After despeckle: pixels with fewer than 2 hot 8-neighbours are removed (red).
cv_u1_c_despeckle.png.how: cv::despeckle on the mask; removed = mask and not cleaned.

cv_u1_d_components.png.caption: (d) Connected components (two-pass labelling, union-find, 8-connectivity), one random colour per label.
cv_u1_d_components.png.how: cv::labelComponents; colour = hash of the label.

cv_u1_e_overlay.png.caption: (e) Accepted blobs: bounding box (cyan), centroid (white cross), principal axes from the second central moments (yellow = major, magenta = minor, length 2 sigma); rejected components in red.
cv_u1_e_overlay.png.how: Moments recomputed from the labelled pixels; the target filter is CvConfig (area, hot core, elongation).

cv_f_external.png.caption: (f) The same simulation frame from an external camera: both UAVs, the confirmed track with its uncertainty, and each UAV's pixel ray to the target.
cv_f_external.png.how: Renderer::beginFrame/endFrame on the live scene, Hud brackets from projectMarker, tracks from the squad's MultiTracker.

cv_strip.png.caption: Six frames, 0.15 s apart: the detection box follows the rover; white trail = centroid history.
cv_strip.png.how: Frames captured while stepping the simulation; cv::detectTargets on each; track id = nearest track to the blob's ground point.

cv_frame.json.caption: Measurement numbers of the frame: per UAV Otsu / threshold / counts, per blob area, centroid, orientation, elongation, ground point, track id; per track state, sigma, triangulation residual and error against the rover's true position.

materials_grid.png.caption: Material grid: 5 x 5 spheres, roughness 0.1-0.9 (columns) x metalness 0 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 (rows), copper albedo, lit by a moon-like directional light and one point lamp; below, the Blinn-Phong row (shininess 4 / 16 / 64 / 256).
materials_grid.png.how: Real PBR shader (GGX / Cook-Torrance, uPbr = 1) on a LabStage of unit spheres; the Blinn-Phong row uses RenderSettings::pbr = false. HIGH quality, no fog.

shading_uav_compare.png.caption: The UAV (hierarchical composite of unit primitives) with the shading override flat / Gouraud / Phong and a hidden-line wireframe of its triangles.
shading_uav_compare.png.how: RenderSettings::shading = Flat / Gouraud / Phong, isolate = Autonomous UAV; wire: view Diagnostic + EdgeMode::HiddenLine.

shading_sphere_compare.png.caption: A coarse 10x6 sphere (top row) and the stock 36x18 sphere (bottom row): flat facets, Gouraud Mach bands and a lost / smeared highlight, Phong, and the triangles.
shading_sphere_compare.png.how: Renderer::labSphereResolution swaps the sphere mesh; Blinn-Phong terms (pbr = false) so the highlight shows the interpolation difference.

relief_compare.png.caption: Procedural surface relief OFF (top) and ON (bottom) on corrugated metal, steel plate, HESCO, concrete, rock and asphalt under raking light.
relief_compare.png.how: RenderSettings::bumpOn -> uniform uBumpOff in surfaceBump(); cubes on a LabStage, HIGH quality.

reflections_compare.png.caption: Wet ground in rain: SSR off, SSR on, the reflectivity buffer (surface target alpha) and the amplified difference.
reflections_compare.png.how: RenderSettings::ssrOn on the live scene (wetness 1, rain 1, ULTRA); buffer read with Renderer::labReadBuffer.

buffers_overview.png.caption: The render pipeline buffers of one frame: moon shadow maps, depth, normals, SSAO, fog in-scatter and transmittance, HDR colour and its false-colour log luminance, bloom, reflectivity, final.
